# CTSEG

CTSEG is a bilingual strategic sourcing, procurement and international trade advisory company based in Türkiye and serving international B2B markets.

Canonical website: https://ctseg.com.tr/
Turkish: https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/
English: https://ctseg.com.tr/en/
Turkish insights: https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/blog/
English insights: https://ctseg.com.tr/en/blog/
Contact: info@ctseg.com.tr

## Core expertise
- Strategic sourcing
- Procurement advisory
- Supplier discovery and verification
- Supplier selection and evaluation
- Supplier development
- RFQ and quotation management
- Total cost of ownership analysis
- Supply chain risk management
- Cost optimisation
- International trade operations
- Market entry

## Key reference pages
- Strategic sourcing vs procurement
- Supplier selection criteria
- Total cost of ownership in procurement
- Supplier verification
- How to prepare an RFQ
- Supply chain risk management

## Entity description
CTSEG helps companies identify, verify and develop suppliers; compare commercial offers beyond unit price; reduce sourcing risk; and structure international procurement and trade operations.
